findings.summary: The decodePng leg is titled 'one CI run checks it against the browser', but it passes as soon as some workflow file contains FLUXION_PNG_CHECK: 1. No nightly has run since 819cfaf, so png-check has never run. Every nightly is red for expected reasons (visual-xos per ADR-0202, previous-playwright per ADR-0215), and ci-evidence reads only the nightly's perf job. So a failing png-check would leave m19-complete green. The row's acceptance allows this ('set in its workflow'), but M18 cp51 F4 asked that the browser check actually run.

findings.summary: ADR-0219 says 'Not covered: hideMasterElements, region texts and icons (FR-SHP-007) and the edit language's patch ops; each needs its own row'. No row exists in this backlog or in a later milestone, so the gap is recorded only in an ADR. FluxScript cannot yet write or decompile a screen that hides its master's elements, a card's text regions or its icon slots. The decompiler leaves those records out, so FR-DSL-002's round trip is weaker for M19 documents.

findings.summary: cp5's Learned rule (a commit that carries minors creates or amends the receiving row in that commit) was broken twice more in this delta. (a) 24a5473 says its r2 minor goes to M19.40 (the guide line 'Every action here is one step in the undo history' also covers opening a master and finding), but M19.40's row is unchanged. (b) c37f51d says its r1 minor 'becomes a backlog row with the next commit', and M19.51 arrived only in d3a64fe. M19.30 is also marked done while its guide and section 3.9 describe M19.40 (painter UI), M19.43 (cell text editing) and M19.38 (icon-slot loading) as pending or leave them out, and no row is asked to update the docs when those land. After cp1, cp4, cp5 and now cp6, a Learned line is clearly not enough to hold this rule.

It does not catch the next harness file that loads the config in a child process or reads it as text, the same blind spot that let 43783755715 through. dispositions.note: New row M19.52 (HARNESS): the decodePng leg, or ci-evidence's nightly reading, requires a recorded nightly run at or after 819cfaf whose png-check job concluded success (for example check-ci-evidence --record also stores the png-check job's conclusion, and the leg reads it), with a milestone-checks case where a red png-check fails the leg. Until such a nightly is recorded, the leg stays red.

M20 (DSL round-trip, FR-DSL-008) gets a row citing 'M19 cp6 F2': FluxScript keys and decompile for hideMasterElements, region texts and icon slots, and the edit language's patch ops for masters, placeholders, tables and frames, under ADR-0219 or a successor. Add a roadmap Deferred row citing 'cp6 F2' that names M19 and M20. The ADR-0219 'Not covered' line is then amended to cite that row.

Amend M19.40 now, in the cp6 record commit: the guide's undo line is reworded so that opening a master and finding are not called undo steps. Amend M19.43 and M19.38: each updates 04-rendering-and-editor.md section 3.9 and guides/frames-tables-masters.md for its feature. New row M19.53 (HARNESS): check-commit-msg or check-digest refuses a task commit whose body says a minor is 'carried to <row>' or 'becomes a backlog row' unless that commit's backlog diff adds or changes the named row, with a harness case. The c37f51d instance needs nothing more: M19.51 exists and is done.

Each repeat was caught by CI and fixed with a Fixes-ci row, so no requirement was lost. Running every e2e spec in the staged ladder would break NFR-DX-002. The cp6 Learned line widens cp3's rule from menus to any change that alters what a spec reads (decompiler subset, menus, writable keys): grep e2e/ for the changed feature's name and run those specs before review. M19.28's test-speed work is where an affected-spec map belongs, if one is built.

The list is correct at 24a5473, and a miss fails CI, not the product, so it is caught one commit late, as 43783755715 was. A derived mapping (harness files whose source names vitest.config) is a cheap follow-up for the next edit of ladder-scope.mjs's NAMED_PATH_HARNESS, with a case that adds a sandbox harness file reading the config and expects it in scope.

planDelta: 51 rows against 31 planned (1.65x); cp6's M19.52 and M19.53 make 53 (1.71x). This delta added four rows: M19.48 (cp5's reopens), M19.49 (CI red from an unrun source-view e2e), and M19.50 and M19.51 (CI red, then the staged ladder's blind spot for vitest.config.ts). The pattern from cp5 holds: each feature or harness row costs about two commits, and the second is now as often a CI-red fix as a review-minors row. 8 rows remain todo plus the two new ones: M19.28 (cold setup, contract with the gate leg), M19.29, M19.35, M19.38, M19.40 (reviewed and held), M19.42, M19.43 and M19.31. M19.35 and M19.42 still hold five checkpoints of hygiene, so cp4's advice to split them stands. M19.30 closed before four feature rows did, so M19.38, M19.40 and M19.43 now carry the doc updates. Later milestones should plan docs last, after every feature row, and budget a CI-red row for each feature that changes something an e2e spec reads.
